notes: Raw completion prompts, not chat templates. Corpus continuation contains one source prefix only, with no repeated passage inside the request. No context length is inferred or silently truncated; runner records actual prompt token count from /tokenize.
corpus_texts: Harbor maintenance notebook, entry twenty-seven. The copper lantern stood beside the eastern gate while Mira checked the tide chart. At dawn she carried three clean lenses to the workshop, labeled each wooden drawer, and wrote the water temperature in a blue ledger. Across the inlet a small ferry sounded its bell. The keeper answered with a green flag, then closed the cabinet before the rain arrived. By noon the fog had lifted and every marker along the channel was visible from the upper window.

A deterministic queue processes records in arrival order. Assign each record a monotonically increasing sequence number, store the immutable payload beside that number, and acknowledge only after the append has completed. On recovery, scan complete entries, reject a partial final record, and resume from the greatest committed sequence. A consumer may remember its own cursor, but it must not reinterpret an uncommitted write as a successful delivery. This simple rule keeps replay predictable when a process stops between two operations.
